question.problem:
$$
{∬}_{D}\boxed{}\,\text{d}A,\,D=\{(y,z)\,:\,\boxed{}\,\}
$$

The integral above gives the surface area of the part of the surface $x={y}^{3}+{e}^{z}$ that lies inside the elliptical cylinder $\frac{{y}^{2}}{4}+\frac{{z}^{2}}{9}=1.$ From left to right, what are the missing expressions?
question.worked_solution:
For a surface $S$ defined by $x=f(y,z)$ with $(y,z)\in D,$ the surface area of $S$ is given by

$$
{∬}_{S}\,\text{d}S={∬}_{D}\sqrt{1+{(\frac{∂x}{∂y})}^{2}+{(\frac{∂x}{∂z})}^{2}}\,\text{d}A.
$$

In this case, our surface is given by

$$
x={y}^{3}+{e}^{z},\,\frac{{y}^{2}}{4}+\frac{{z}^{2}}{9}\le 1.
$$

Now, since

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∂x}{∂y} & =\frac{∂}{∂y}({y}^{3}+{e}^{z})=3{y}^{2}, \\ \frac{∂x}{∂z} & =\frac{∂}{∂z}({y}^{3}+{e}^{z})={e}^{z},\end{aligned}
$$

the surface area is

$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{S}\,\text{d}S & ={∬}_{D}\sqrt{1+{(\frac{∂x}{∂y})}^{2}+{(\frac{∂y}{∂z})}^{2}}\,\text{d}A \\  & ={∬}_{D}\sqrt{1+{(3{y}^{2})}^{2}+({e}^{z})^{2}}\,\text{d}A \\  & ={∬}_{D}\sqrt{1+9{y}^{4}+{e}^{2z}}\,\text{d}A.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the correct answer is

$\,$ $\sqrt{1+9{y}^{4}+{e}^{2z}}\,$ and $\,\frac{{y}^{2}}{4}+\frac{{z}^{2}}{9}\le 1.$
